name: Top Bright Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Top Bright Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, marketing, research and development of electronic scales and electronic materials. It operates through Electronic Materials Department and The Scales Department. The Electronic Materials Department segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic materials. The Scales Department segment is involved in the development, production, and sales of the scales. The company was founded on November 8, 2013 and is headquartered in New Taipei, Taiwan.
